headline: Gold drops to one-year low amid geopolitical tensions
summary: Safe-haven gold fell to its lowest price in a year despite potential Middle East attacks following the U.S. midterm elections.
why: Gold is widely used by professional investors as a safe-haven asset during times of geopolitical uncertainty and inflation, making price fluctuations critical for portfolio hedging.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices fell to their lowest level in a year according to market reports.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
